profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Sensitive and affectionate, the Collie tends to seek human company and responds readily to learning. Its Scottish herding heritage lives on in an alert watchdog manner, a fondness for play and participation in obedience, agility and herding trials. The long-coated Rough and short-coated Smooth varieties share this character and differ in coat.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A sensitive, affectionate companion with a herding heritage, the Collie includes both Rough and Smooth coats.
